_doc: MCP servers the ?? agent may use. 'python' = the agent's own interpreter.
kind (per server, or per tool under 'tools'):
private   - reads data about YOUR machine; results are remembered so they cannot be sent out
untrusted - returns third-party text; quarantined + taints the session
egress    - sends something out (URL / query) AND returns untrusted text; gated by provenance + leak checks
sandbox   - executes code in an isolated, network-free, throwaway environment (servers/sandbox.py);
the ONLY exception to 'nothing executes' in this project, scoped to code that cannot touch
the real machine or network at all — output treated like 'private' (leak-checked, no taint)
Only tools the server marks readOnlyHint=true, or that are listed under 'tools', are exposed — this is
how a write/execute-capable tool gets exposed on purpose (sandbox's run_python/run_shell below); every
other non-readOnlyHint tool stays hidden even if the server offers it.
